cover.alt: ITTI to Host Orientation for New Aviation and Tourism Students

html:
The International Travel and Tourism Institute (ITTI) has announced plans to organize an orientation programme for prospective students enrolled in its upcoming professional training batches.

The orientation will cater to students admitted into Airport Passenger Services and Operations (APH) Batch 104, Cabin Crew Batch 03, Foundation in Travel and Tourism (FTT) Batch 53, and Customer Relations (C&R) Batch 10.

Scheduled for January 8, 2026, at 10:00 a.m., the programme aims to formally welcome new students and provide them with essential information about their respective courses, academic expectations, and career pathways within the aviation and tourism industry.

ITTI’s orientation programme forms a key part of the institute’s commitment to preparing students for successful careers by ensuring they are well-informed and properly inducted before the commencement of lectures.

Date: Thursday, 8th January 2026

Venue: ITTI School Premises

Time: 10:00 am
